Operator-based epoch de-mixing and gain-corrected trial regression across lags

Source: R/diagnose_crossrun_recovery.R
decon_epoch_regression.Rd

Estimate trial-by-trial correlations and regression slopes across epoch lags relative to a target event while removing preceding/neighboring event leakage and correcting regularization-induced amplitude attenuation.

Usage

decon_epoch_regression(
  deconvolution,
  covariates,
  events = NULL,
  target_condition = NULL,
  lags = seq(-2, 4, by = 1),
  readout_kernel = c("triangle", "linear", "boxcar", "gaussian"),
  readout_width = NULL,
  demix_other_events = TRUE,
  demix_target_trials = TRUE,
  demix_ridge = 0.05,
  gain_floor = 0.05,
  restore_scale = FALSE,
  source_model = c("impulse", "window", "duration"),
  trial_durations = NULL,
  duration_scale = c("rate", "integral"),
  return_epochs = FALSE,
  return_panel = FALSE
)

Arguments

deconvolution

Result of deconvolve_crossrun_hrf().

covariates

Numeric vector, matrix, or data.frame of trial-level predictors for target trials (concatenated across runs or supplied as a run-named list matching deconvolution$hrf_fit$run_ids).

events

Optional run-named list of event data.frames with onset and optional condition and duration. Defaults to the HRF fit's event tables.

target_condition

Optional character scalar naming the target event condition in events[[r]]$condition (e.g., "feedback").

lags

Numeric vector of epoch readout lags (in seconds) relative to each target event onset.

readout_kernel

Epoch readout kernel: "triangle", "linear", "boxcar", or "gaussian".

readout_width

Optional kernel full width in seconds for non-linear readouts (defaults to 1.5 * tr).

demix_other_events

Logical; whether to estimate non-target event amplitudes at their own onsets and subtract their operator-predicted leakage into each target epoch lag. Default: TRUE.

demix_target_trials

Logical; whether to use the stratum resolution matrix at each lag to de-mix adjacent target-trial overlap and correct amplitude attenuation. Default: TRUE.

demix_ridge

Positive ridge stabilization parameter for unit-diagonal cross-talk inversion. Default: 0.05.

gain_floor

Minimum absolute operator gain used when correcting amplitude slopes. Default: 0.05.

restore_scale

Logical; if TRUE, multiplies each run and voxel by its recorded deconvolution$scaling[[r]]$scale divisor. Default: FALSE.

source_model

Forward neural source model at each target lag: "impulse" (default unit impulse at onset + lag), "window" (local sustained boxcar of width readout_width centered at onset + lag), or "duration" (trial-varying sustained boxcar over [onset + lag, onset + lag + d_i] using each target trial's duration d_i from trial_durations or events[[r]]$duration, with duration-matched readout and unpenalized baseline-rate de-confounding).

trial_durations

Optional numeric vector (concatenated across runs) or run-named list of non-negative target trial durations (in seconds), such as per-trial reaction times. Overrides events[[r]]$duration for target trials and defaults source_model to "duration" when source_model is not explicitly specified.

duration_scale

Scaling convention for positive-duration target trials when source_model = "duration": "rate" (default; trial amplitude represents neural firing rate / boxcar height per TR bin) or "integral" (each trial boxcar is normalized to unit time-integrated neural mass across its duration).

return_epochs

Logical; whether to include raw and de-mixed trial-by-voxel epoch matrices per lag. Default: FALSE.

return_panel

Logical; whether to return a tidy MEDUSA-compatible data.table (panel) for downstream mixed_by() modeling. Default: FALSE.

Value

A list with coefficients (per voxel, lag, and predictor term), summary (averaged across usable voxels per lag and term), optional epochs, optional panel, and settings.
